notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Coverage is very limited: only five cities, all in Generation 3 quality.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Outside the capital the car is silver with a two-bar roof rack and black mirrors; Guatemala has a similar one.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Traffic drives on the right, which separates it from left-driving Thailand.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Short yellow plates on private cars, unlike white in Thailand and Cambodia; commercial plates are white and government ones blue.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Compact curvy script with marks above and below letters; looks like Thai but with fewer straight lines.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Buddhist temples with ornate decoration and gold leaf are a common sight.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Striped curbs in red, yellow or black and white appear throughout.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Stop signs use the local script, with just two characters versus three in Thailand.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Square concrete poles with a row of small holes down the sides; Thailand and Sri Lanka have similar ones.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Square concrete bollards in black and white with one or more black bands.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Some lamp posts have diagonal red and white stripes that stop above the base.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: A red and white painted concrete block sometimes sits a few metres off the road.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Red flags with a hammer and sickle can sometimes be seen.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Former royal capital on a river with low hills, palms, dark wooden buildings and some French colonial houses.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Blue sign backs within the country are only found in Luang Prabang.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A rugged mountain range is visible almost everywhere, and many tourist signs for guesthouses.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The capital area is the only one where the Google car is not visible, with large city views and plenty of rural coverage.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Very flat, slightly red-tinged soil; the only mountains seen are across the river in the neighbouring country.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Distinct red soil, dry vegetation and dry hills nearby; a 1,380 m bridge crosses the Mekong here.
